tagline: Make it simple to connect and do business
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Payment Volume (TPV) is the primary indicator of network momentum and platform adoption, directly reflecting the economic activity generated by SMB customers, and acts as a structural driver of future transaction and interest revenue growth.

kpis.name: Total Payment Volume
kpis.explanation: Total amount of payments processed on the platform during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: TPV measures the economic activity flowing through the platform. A high TPV indicates strong usage and customer loyalty, which strengthens the potential for future revenues from transaction fees and interest income.
kpis.signal: Growing ecosystem: 493,800 customer businesses and 8.3 million network members.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from subscriptions, transactions, and interest on held funds.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached $1.5B in 2025, up 13.3% from $1.3B in 2024, driven by subscriptions, transactions, and interest income.
kpis.signal: Solid double-digit growth despite macroeconomic headwinds.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income was $23.8M in 2025, compared to a loss of $28.9M in 2024, marking a significant improvement in profitability.
kpis.signal: Turned profitable in 2025 after a loss in 2024.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of services, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not provided in the extracted documents.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is not provided in the extracted documents.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses as a percentage of revenue are not available.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Data on capital expenditures is not provided.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Employee count is not mentioned in the provided documents.

kpis.name: Customer Count
kpis.explanation: Number of businesses using BILL's solutions.
kpis.description: 493,800 businesses used BILL's solutions as of June 30, 2025, indicating continued platform adoption.
kpis.signal: Growing customer base, reflecting network expansion.

kpis.name: Network Members
kpis.explanation: Total number of members (customers, suppliers, partners) on the platform.
kpis.description: The network includes 8.3 million members who sent or received funds via the platform as of June 30, 2025.
kpis.signal: Expanding ecosystem: over 8 million connected members.

risks.title: Prior Operating Losses
risks.score_rationale: History of operating losses with recent turnaround in FY2025 but uncertainty around the sustainability of future profitability

risks.title: SMB Dependence
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenue comes from small and medium-sized businesses, which are more sensitive to economic fluctuations and likely to reduce spending during downturns

risks.title: Credit Risk (BILL Divvy Card)
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to credit risk through the BILL Divvy Card with obligations to purchase full participation in originated receivables

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competitive market for SMB financial solutions requiring continuous differentiation

risks.title: Strict Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Operations in the financial services sector subject to complex and evolving regulations

risks.title: Dependence on Strategic Partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Go-to-market model reliant on partners (accounting firms, financial institutions, software vendors)

risks.title: Technology and AI Risks
risks.score_rationale: AI-enabled platform with risks related to security, algorithm reliability, and rapid technological change

ai_positioning.summary: BILL explicitly integrates artificial intelligence into its financial platform. The company describes its platform as a 'purpose-built, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled financial software platform' that automates SMB back-office operations and helps automate data capture, approval routing, and duplicate invoice detection.
evidence: Purpose-built, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled financial software platform creates seamless connections
Our AI-enabled platform helps businesses using our solutions pay their bills efficiently and get paid faster
We provide tools that streamline the transaction lifecycle by automating data capture and entry, routing bills for approval, and detecting duplicate invoices
